import serial
import time

port = '/dev/cu.usbserial-110'
deadline = time.monotonic() + 120.0
print(f'SERIAL_CAPTURE_BEGIN port={port} seconds=120', flush=True)
with serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=1.0) as ser:
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        raw = ser.readline()
        if raw:
            line = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').rstrip()
            low = line.lower()
            if 'climate_stage27' in line or 'guru meditation' in low or 'watchdog' in low or 'panic' in low:
                print(line, flush=True)
print('SERIAL_CAPTURE_END', flush=True)
PY
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

text = Path('/tmp/stage27c-soak-diag-hw-v2.log').read_text(errors='replace')
assert not re.search(r'Guru Meditation|Task watchdog|panic|abort\(\)', text, re.IGNORECASE), 'crash/watchdog evidence present'
assert 'outputs=fake-locked' in text
assert 'rtc_available=1 rtc_trusted=1' in text
assert 'ble_scanning=1' in text
pattern = re.compile(
    r'soak uptime_ms=(\d+) reset_reason=(\d+) heap_internal=(\d+) heap_internal_min=(\d+) '
    r'heap_psram=(\d+) heap_psram_min=(\d+) scd_t=([-+0-9.]+) scd_rh=([-+0-9.]+) '
    r'scd_co2=([-+0-9.]+) scd_age_ms=(\d+) scd_read_errors=(\d+) scd_invalid=(\d+) '
    r'scd_samples=(\d+) tp_age_ms=(\d+) tp_packets=(\d+) tp_accepted=(\d+) tp_rejected=(\d+) '
    r'xiaomi_age_ms=(\d+) xiaomi_packets=(\d+) xiaomi_accepted=(\d+) xiaomi_rejected=(\d+) '
    r'outputs=fake-locked'
)
rows = []
for m in pattern.finditer(text):
    g = m.groups()
    vals = [int(g[i]) for i in range(6)] + [float(g[i]) for i in range(6,9)] + [int(g[i]) for i in range(9,21)]
    rows.append(vals)
assert len(rows) >= 8, f'need at least 8 soak rows, got {len(rows)}'
steady = [r for r in rows if r[12] > 0 and r[15] > 0 and r[19] > 0]
assert len(steady) >= 5, f'need at least 5 steady-state rows, got {len(steady)}'

uptimes = [r[0] for r in steady]
assert all(b > a for a, b in zip(uptimes, uptimes[1:])), uptimes
assert len({r[1] for r in steady}) == 1, 'reset reason changed during steady-state capture'

for r in steady:
    uptime, reset, hi, himin, hp, hpmin, scd_t, scd_rh, scd_co2, scd_age, scd_err, scd_invalid, scd_samples, tp_age, tp_packets, tp_acc, tp_rej, xi_age, xi_packets, xi_acc, xi_rej = r
    assert hi > 0 and himin > 0 and himin <= hi
    assert hp > 0 and hpmin > 0 and hpmin <= hp
    assert -45.0 <= scd_t <= 130.0 and 0.0 <= scd_rh <= 100.0 and scd_co2 > 0.0
    assert scd_age <= 30000
    assert tp_packets > 0 and tp_acc > 0 and tp_acc <= tp_packets and tp_rej <= tp_packets
    assert xi_packets > 0 and xi_acc > 0 and xi_acc <= xi_packets and xi_rej <= xi_packets
    assert tp_age <= 60000 and xi_age <= 60000

for idx in (10,11,12,14,15,16,18,19,20):
    seq = [r[idx] for r in steady]
    assert all(b >= a for a, b in zip(seq, seq[1:])), (idx, seq)

first, last = steady[0], steady[-1]
print(
    'SOAK_DIAGNOSTICS_HARDWARE_GATE_PASS '
    f'rows={len(rows)} steady_rows={len(steady)} '
    f'uptime_start={first[0]} uptime_end={last[0]} reset_reason={last[1]} '
    f'heap_internal_start={first[2]} heap_internal_end={last[2]} heap_internal_min={last[3]} '
    f'heap_psram_start={first[4]} heap_psram_end={last[4]} heap_psram_min={last[5]} '
    f'scd_samples={last[12]} scd_read_errors={last[10]} scd_invalid={last[11]} '
    f'tp_packets={last[14]} tp_accepted={last[15]} tp_rejected={last[16]} '
    f'xiaomi_packets={last[18]} xiaomi_accepted={last[19]} xiaomi_rejected={last[20]}'
)
PY
